summary.verdict_desc: 本周计数 6 红 / 8 黄 / 11 绿，红灯比例由 28.0% 回落至 24.0%、加权风险分由 42.0% 微降至 40.0%——头条读数本周降温，但这不是风险消退，而是风险在体系内『换轴』：表面两处好转（capex 反应、市场广度）掩盖了一处最要害的恶化（信用侧首次裂缝）。三处状态迁移：其一，资本开支市场反应由红回落至黄。上周 Alphabet 因加码 capex 被重罚、判为『系统性惩罚』红灯，本周 MSFT/Meta（7/29）、Amazon（7/30）三家 Q2 落地，市场明确『分化』而非无差别惩罚——MSFT 财报后 7/30 暴涨约 15-16%、单日市值增加约 $4500 亿（史上单只个股最大单日美元增值），Azure +43%、商业 RPO 升至 $678B（+84%）；Amazon 涨约 10%，AWS +37%（18 个季度最快）、RPO 升至 $496B（环比 +$132B）；唯 Meta 跌约 9%，因自由现金流塌陷至 $784M（同比约 -91%）而 capex 底线上调。市场奖励『有需求佐证的 capex』、只惩罚『烧现金无对价的 capex』——反应函数由无差别惩罚（红）回到选择性/偶发惩罚（黄）。这对多头是实质性利好：上周的『系统性惩罚』判定被证明过早。其二，市场广度由黄转绿。S5FI 现值约 71.6%（7/31，环比 +约 22 个百分点），受 MSFT 财报暴涨领动，为 2 月以来多数个股首次重回 50 日均线上方——广度急剧修复。其三，也是最重要的：Neocloud 信用由绿转黄（进入 Watch）。CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 本周暴走至约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内股价 -36%；Moody's 于 7 月对 AI capex 威胁 MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL/CoreWeave（合计约 $460B 债务）信用质量发出行业预警。虽无已确认的评级下调/违约（S&P 反将 CoreWeave 展望调至正面、Moody's 给其某担保工具 A3、Nebius $775M 定期贷款顺利落地），但 CDS 定价 + 行业预警已达『观察』门槛——这是本体系最看重的信用轴（trigger）上首次出现裂缝，且是从最脆弱的高杠杆 neocloud/GPU 抵押端先崩，正是经典晚周期序列：宽口径信用（HY 利差、DC ABS）仍平静，边际杠杆借款人先出事。动量：1 处恶化 / 2 处好转，净 -1（未及 ±4 阈值）。两轴判读：泡沫成熟度 stage 维持 60.0（亢奋 Euphoria 未改——估值、VC 集中度、vendor financing 依旧泡沫化），破裂临近度 trigger 由 30.0 微降至 26.7（capex 惩罚缓和 + 广度修复压过 neocloud 裂缝），仍处『零星火花 Sparks』区间。关键悖论：尽管头条降温，当前格局与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）的相似度反而由 74% 升至 76%、更明确地反超 1999-06（顶前 9 个月，70%）——驱动正是 neocloud 信用转黄，使当前向量在信用轴上恰好对齐 2000-02，也就是说本周的『好转』发生在慢变量表象，而向量收敛却发生在最危险的信用轴。估值端极端未改：CAPE 约 41.0（multpl 40.91、GuruFocus 41.29），逼近 2000 峰值 44.2；S&P 前 5 大权重约 28%（MSFT 因 +15.5% 财报升至约 6.9%、NVDA 约 7.7% 续居首，前 5 单类约 27.1%/含 Alphabet 双类约 29.0%），集中度创纪录；唯 NVDA 远期 PE 约 22x 维持绿灯。资金面仍是最大压力源（类别分 87.5、3 红）：Mag4 FCF 红灯本周由 Alphabet 扩散至 Meta（-91%）与 Amazon（TTM 转负 -$7.6B），仅 MSFT 仍正（$19.6B）；AI 占全球 VC 约 70%（美国 H1 86%）；NVDA 客户投资/收入约 43%（承诺额自 5 月约 $40B 持平至边际收敛，Nvidia 已暂停对 OpenAI/Anthropic 的新投，循环融资口实仍在，常红第 N 期但二阶收敛）。信用面整体仍是最强支撑（类别分由 12.5 升至 25.0，因 neocloud 转黄）：HY 利差约 284bps（Convex 7/30，环比 +7bps，仍远低于 350 阈值）、DC ABS 最紧（Cloud Capital 7/29 完成 $520M 三 AAA ABS、称利差为中东冲突以来 DC ABS 最紧）——但需并记蓝筹 DC 债成本抬升：Meta/BlackRock 7/27 定价 $12.5B、收益率约 7.53%、认购覆盖由 2 月约 5x 降至 <2x，为本轮 binge 蓝筹 DC 债最高收益之一。基本面维持类别分 8.3：token 绝对量本周升破约 100T/月平台至约 125T/月（+约 25%，静态锚打破，撤下 suspect_static，但底层 tracker 数据约 4-8 周旧）；GPU 现货 H100 on-demand 由约 $3.94 边际转松至约 $3.2-3.5、H200 大体持平、无过剩（企稳偏紧仍绿，转松为下期需盯的软信号）；ARR 二阶导维持黄（Anthropic 7 月约 $74.1B、单月增量约 +$4.5B 续弱，OpenAI 约 $41.3B 仍加速，无 8 月新披露）；云 RPO 强劲加速（大三 >$1.69T）；前沿进展偏加速（近 90 天 Claude Opus 5 7/24、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.5 7/8 密集发布，METR 倍增时间由约 7 月缩至约 4 月）。宏观情绪：Fed 于 7/29 维持 3.50-3.75%（第 5 次连续维持，9-3 投票、3 位异议者要求加息），市场现已定价 2026 年两次加息、2027 年前无降息——鹰派倾斜加深，『降息=绿』情景出局，但实际动作仍是维持，未改判黄；capex 反应转黄（见上）；CEO 对冲维持黄（Altman 本月以 dot-com 泡沫类比 AI、称部分小盘估值『膨胀』，但各家仍集体加码 capex 未收手）。判读：基础档位按 red_pct 24.0%（<25）本已回落至『观察期』，但估值 2 红（CAPE、Top-5）叠加资金面 3 红（FCF、VC AI 占比、NVDA 客户投资），估值 + 资金面双类共振触发分类强制升级，维持『高风险预警』。两轴升级条件（stage≥60 且 trigger≥50）因 trigger 仅 26.7 仍未触发。历史相似度：当前格局最像 2000-02（顶前 1 个月，76%），且因 neocloud 信用裂缝进一步反超 1999-06（70%）；2021-11（68%）居三，2007-10（41%）最不像。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）向量的主要差异（即接下来确认进入顶部前夜要盯的信号）：市场广度仍健康（本周刚急升至约 72% vs 2000 崩溃）、NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（约 22x）、宽口径信用仍未破（HY 284bps / DC ABS 最紧，vs 2000 走阔——但 neocloud 一角本周已裂、缺口收窄）、IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 瞄准 10 月但临近名单仍 <10）、Fed 维持而非明确加息。分母提醒：N=25 下 6 红对应 24.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。一句话：『头条本周降温，但降温发生在慢变量表象、裂缝出现在信用轴要害——不要被 24% 的红灯比例误导，本周真正的新信息是 CoreWeave 引线冒烟。』（动量净 -1，2 好转 1 恶化，未及 ±4 阈值。）
summary.verdict_desc_en: This week prints 6 red / 8 yellow / 11 green, with the red share easing from 28.0% to 24.0% and the weighted risk score from 42.0% to 40.0% — the headline cooled, but this is not risk receding so much as risk rotating axes within the framework: two surface improvements (capex reaction, market breadth) mask the single most consequential deterioration (the first crack on the credit side). Three status migrations. First, the capex-guidance reaction eased from red back to yellow. Last week Alphabet was punished hard for leaning into capex and the read was 'systematic punishment' (red); this week MSFT/Meta (July 29) and Amazon (July 30) reported Q2, and the market clearly discriminated rather than punished indiscriminately — Microsoft surged ~15-16% on July 30 for a ~$450B single-day market-cap gain (the largest one-day dollar gain for any stock in history), with Azure +43% and commercial RPO up to $678B (+84%); Amazon rose ~10% on AWS +37% (its fastest in 18 quarters) and RPO up to $496B (+$132B sequentially); only Meta fell ~9%, as free cash flow collapsed to $784M (~-91% YoY) against a raised capex floor. The market rewarded capex backed by demonstrated demand and punished only capex that burns cash without a matching top line — the reaction function moved from indiscriminate punishment (red) back to selective/episodic punishment (yellow). This is a real positive for the bull case: last week's 'systematic punishment' call proved premature. Second, market breadth turned from yellow to green. S5FI is ~71.6% (July 31, +~22 points week-over-week), led by Microsoft's earnings surge — the first time since February that most stocks are back above their 50-day MA, a sharp breadth repair. Third, and most important: neocloud credit turned from green to yellow (onto Watch). CoreWeave's 5-year CDS blew out to ~855bps this week, implying ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% over the month; Moody's issued a July sector warning that AI capex threatens the credit quality of MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL/CoreWeave (~$460B combined debt). There is no confirmed downgrade or default yet (S&P actually revised CoreWeave's outlook to Positive, Moody's assigned A3 to one secured facility, and Nebius closed a $775M term loan cleanly), but the CDS repricing plus the sector warning meet the 'watch' threshold — the first crack on the credit axis (trigger) this framework weights most, and it broke first at the most fragile, highly levered neocloud/GPU-collateralized end. That is the classic late-cycle sequence: broad credit (HY spreads, data-center ABS) stays calm while the marginal levered borrower blows out first. Momentum: one deterioration, two improvements, net -1 (below the ±4 threshold). Two-axis read: bubble maturity 'stage' holds at 60.0 (Euphoria unchanged — valuations, VC concentration and vendor financing remain bubble-grade), while rupture proximity 'trigger' eased from 30.0 to 26.7 (the softer capex punishment and breadth repair outweighed the neocloud crack), still inside 'Sparks'. The key paradox: even as the headline cooled, the current configuration's similarity to February 2000 (one month before the top) rose from 74% to 76%, pulling further ahead of June 1999 (nine months before the top, 70%) — driven precisely by neocloud credit turning yellow, which aligns the current vector with February 2000 on the credit axis. In other words, this week's 'improvements' occurred in the slow-variable surface while the vector converged on the most dangerous axis of all. Valuations stay extreme: CAPE ~41.0 (multpl 40.91, GuruFocus 41.29), edging toward the 2000 peak of 44.2; the S&P Top-5 weight is ~28% (Microsoft rose to ~6.9% on its +15.5% earnings move, NVDA still #1 at ~7.7%; Top-5 ~27.1% single-class / ~29.0% counting Alphabet's dual classes), a record concentration; only NVDA's ~22x forward PE stays green. Capital remains the biggest pressure point (category 87.5, three reds): the Mag4 FCF red spread this week from Alphabet to Meta (-91%) and Amazon (TTM negative -$7.6B), with only MSFT still positive ($19.6B); AI is ~70% of global VC (86% of US H1); and NVDA customer-financing runs ~43% of revenue (commitments flat-to-contracting from ~$40B since May, with Nvidia now pausing new OpenAI/Anthropic bets — the circular-financing critique intact, a persistent red but with commitments decelerating). Credit remains the strongest overall support (category up from 12.5 to 25.0 on the neocloud yellow): HY OAS ~284bps (Convex July 30, +7bps, still far below the 350 threshold) and data-center ABS at its tightest (Cloud Capital closed a $520M triple-AAA ABS on July 29, called the tightest DC-ABS spread since the Mideast conflict) — but note rising blue-chip DC bond costs: Meta/BlackRock priced $12.5B on July 27 at ~7.53% with order coverage down from ~5x in February to <2x, one of the highest yields of the binge. Fundamentals hold at category 8.3: token throughput broke above the ~100T/month plateau to ~125T/month (+~25%, breaking the static anchor, so suspect-static is dropped, though the underlying tracker data is ~4-8 weeks old); GPU spot H100 on-demand softened from ~$3.94 to ~$3.2-3.5 with H200 roughly flat and no glut (firm-and-green still, but the softening is a soft signal to watch next period); the ARR second derivative holds yellow (Anthropic ~$74.1B in July, monthly increment ~+$4.5B still weak, OpenAI ~$41.3B still accelerating, no August print); cloud RPO is strong and accelerating (big-3 >$1.69T); and frontier progress is on-trend-to-accelerating (Claude Opus 5 on July 24, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.5 on July 8 all in the last 90 days, METR doubling shortening from ~7 months to ~4). Macro/sentiment: the Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on July 29 (a fifth consecutive hold, 9-3 vote with three dissents wanting a HIKE), and markets now price two 2026 hikes and no cuts through 2027 — a deeper hawkish tilt that removes the 'cut = green' scenario, though the actual action was a hold, so it is not re-rated (yellow); the capex reaction turns yellow (above); and CEO hedging holds yellow (Altman this month likened AI to the dot-com bubble and called some small-cap valuations 'inflated', yet all majors keep raising capex). Verdict: the base framework has fallen to Observation on red_pct of 24.0% (<25), but valuation 2-red (CAPE, Top-5) plus capital 3-red (FCF, VC AI share, NVDA customer-financing) fire the dual-category resonance override, holding the verdict at High Risk Alert. The two-axis upgrade (stage>=60 and trigger>=50) still does not fire because trigger is only 26.7. Historical similarity: the current configuration most resembles February 2000 (one month before the top, 76%) and, on the neocloud credit crack, pulls further ahead of June 1999 (70%); November 2021 (68%) is third and October 2007 (41%) least alike. The main differences versus the February 2000 vector — the signals to watch to confirm entry into the top's eve — are: market breadth still healthy (it just spiked to ~72% vs a collapse in 2000), NVDA's forward PE still cheap (~22x), broad credit still unbroken (HY 284bps / DC ABS tightest, vs widening in 2000 — though the neocloud corner cracked this week, narrowing the gap), the IPO pipeline not yet a flood (Anthropic targets October but imminent names are still under 10), and the Fed holding rather than clearly hiking. Denominator reminder: with N=25 the six reds map to 24.0%, so cross-period trend comparison should lean on direction. In one line: the headline cooled this week, but the cooling is in the slow-variable surface while the crack is on the credit axis that matters most — don't be misled by a 24% red share; the real new information this week is CoreWeave's fuse starting to smoke. (Net momentum -1, two improvements and one deterioration, below the ±4 threshold.)

wow_changes.note: Neocloud 信用侧首次裂缝——CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 本周暴走至约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内股价 -36%；Moody's 对 AI capex 威胁六大发行人（合计约 $460B 债务）信用质量发出行业预警。虽无已确认降级/违约（S&P 反调 CoreWeave 展望为正面、Nebius $775M 贷款顺利），但 CDS 定价 + 行业预警达『观察』门槛，由绿转黄——本体系最看重的信用轴首现火星，且从最脆弱的高杠杆端先崩
wow_changes.note_en: The first crack on the neocloud credit side — CoreWeave's 5-year CDS blew out to ~855bps this week, implying ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% over the month; Moody's issued a sector warning that AI capex threatens the credit quality of six major issuers (~$460B combined debt). No confirmed downgrade or default yet (S&P revised CoreWeave's outlook to Positive, Nebius closed a $775M loan cleanly), but the CDS repricing plus the sector warning meet the 'watch' threshold — green to yellow. The first spark on the credit axis this framework weights most, breaking first at the most fragile, highly levered end

wow_changes.note: 资本开支市场反应由系统性惩罚回落至选择性惩罚——MSFT/Amazon Q2（7/29-30）因 capex 有需求佐证获奖励（MSFT +约 16%、单日市值增约 $4500 亿创纪录，Azure +43%；Amazon +约 10%，AWS +37%），唯 Meta 因 FCF 塌陷 -91% 被罚约 -9%。市场『分化』而非无差别惩罚，反应函数由红回黄；上周『系统性惩罚』判定被证明过早
wow_changes.note_en: The capex reaction eased from systematic to selective punishment — MSFT and Amazon (Q2, July 29-30) were rewarded for capex backed by demand (MSFT +~16% for a record ~$450B single-day gain, Azure +43%; Amazon +~10%, AWS +37%), and only Meta was punished ~-9% on its -91% FCF collapse. The market discriminated rather than punished indiscriminately, moving the reaction function from red back to yellow; last week's 'systematic punishment' call proved premature

wow_changes.note: 市场广度急剧修复——S5FI 现值约 71.6%（7/31，环比 +约 22 个百分点），受 MSFT 财报 +15.5% 暴涨领动，为 2 月以来多数个股首次重回 50 日均线上方，头部独撑格局本周缓解，由黄转绿
wow_changes.note_en: Market breadth repaired sharply — S5FI is ~71.6% (July 31, +~22 points week-over-week), led by Microsoft's +15.5% earnings surge; for the first time since February most stocks are back above their 50-day MA, easing the narrow-leadership tape this week — yellow to green

wow_changes.note: 本周新增单笔 ≥$10B AI 债务 deal：Meta/BlackRock（Sopaipilla 合资，德州数据中心）7/27 定价 $12.5B IG 债、收益率约 7.53%——为本轮 binge 蓝筹 DC 债最高收益之一，认购覆盖由 2 月约 5x 降至 <2x，蓝筹发行端资金成本抬升。另 Cloud Capital 7/29 完成 $520M 三 AAA DC ABS（<$10B）。台账年化分子仍约 $570B ÷ 分母约 $1.04T ≈ 55%，维持黄灯
wow_changes.note_en: A new single AI debt deal of >=$10B this week: Meta/BlackRock (the Sopaipilla JV, a Texas data center) priced a $12.5B IG bond on July 27 at ~7.53% — one of the highest yields of this binge, with order coverage down from ~5x in February to <2x, signaling a rising cost of capital even for blue-chip sponsors. Separately, Cloud Capital closed a $520M triple-AAA DC ABS on July 29 (<$10B). The ledger's annualized numerator holds at ~$570B over a ~$1.04T denominator ≈ 55%, staying yellow

indicators.note: 二级标价持续走强：Anthropic 隐含估值约 $1.2T（Caplight，+550% YoY，对 $965B Series H 溢价约 24%；Hiive 上 3 月 +211% 至约 $900/股，卖方近乎绝迹，被称『二级市场史上最抢手标的』），已反超 OpenAI；OpenAI 约 $908B（较上周约 $933B 微降，但 GPT-5.6 Sol 发布后买方兴趣回暖，Hiive 3 月 +8.5%）。旗舰均无折价、溢价扩大，一级市场无退潮信号，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: Secondary marks keep firming: Anthropic's implied valuation is ~$1.2T (Caplight, +550% YoY, ~24% above its $965B Series H; +211% over three months on Hiive to ~$900/share with sellers all but absent — 'the most sought-after name the secondary market has ever seen'), now above OpenAI; OpenAI is ~$908B (down slightly from ~$933B last week, but buyer interest rekindled after the GPT-5.6 Sol launch, +8.5% over three months on Hiive). No flagship trades at a discount and premiums are widening — no retreat signal, stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 指引下调=红 / 加速=黄 / 稳健=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut = red / Accelerating = yellow / Steady = green
indicators.note: Q2 财报季本周全部落地、三家均上调无一下调：MSFT 指引 FY27 capex 约 $255-260B（+约 35%）、Q4 单季含租约 $41B；Meta 把 2026 capex 上调至 $130-145B（原 $113-128B）；Amazon 把 2026 上调至约 $220B（原约 $200B），Jassy 称 2027 产能亦已大半锁定。四大 2026e 合计约 $740-770B、YoY 约 +80%。绝对增速仍在加速、不可持续特征明显，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Q2 season fully landed this week and all three raised, none cut: MSFT guided FY27 capex to ~$255-260B (~+35%), with Q4 capex-plus-leases of $41B; Meta raised 2026 capex to $130-145B (from $113-128B); Amazon raised 2026 to ~$220B (from ~$200B), with Jassy noting most 2027 capacity is already reserved. The four now guide ~$740-770B for 2026, ~+80% YoY. The pace is still accelerating with clear unsustainability hallmarks — stays yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20%~0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: FCF 红灯本周由 Alphabet 扩散、坐实：Meta Q2 FCF 塌陷至 $784M（同比约 -91%，$31.1B capex + 一次性法务/遣散费吞噬）、Amazon TTM FCF 转负至 -$7.6B（去年同期 +$18.2B，受净 P&E +$66.1B 拖累），Alphabet Q2 已负 -$5.855B；仅 MSFT 仍正 $19.6B（经营现金流 $55.4B +30%，被 capex 与租约支付抵消）。Mag4 多数由造现金转向吞现金、需外部融资，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: The FCF red spread beyond Alphabet and is confirmed this week: Meta's Q2 FCF collapsed to $784M (~-91% YoY, as $31.1B of capex plus one-time legal/severance charges gutted it), Amazon's TTM FCF swung negative to -$7.6B (from +$18.2B a year ago, dragged by +$66.1B of net P&E), and Alphabet's Q2 was already -$5.855B; only MSFT stays positive at $19.6B (operating cash flow $55.4B +30%, offset by capex and lease payments). Most of the Mag4 have shifted from generating cash to consuming it, leaning on external financing — stays red

indicators.name_zh: AI 占 VC 投资比重
indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 沿用 PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 硬数据（H1 报告仍为最新，无新 Q3 披露）：AI 占全球创投超 70%（一年前不足 50%）、占美国创投 86%（$355.9B）；H1 全球创投创纪录 $510B、OpenAI+Anthropic 两家占 43%（$217B）。美元高度集中于少数巨额轮次，远超 50% 红线，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 hard data is carried (H1 remains the freshest; no new Q3 print): AI took >70% of global VC (up from under 50% a year ago) and 86% of US VC ($355.9B); record H1 global VC of $510B, with OpenAI and Anthropic alone at 43% ($217B). Dollars concentrate in a few mega-rounds far above the 50% red line — stays red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green (Lucent '99 peak: 24%)
indicators.note: 常红处理：NVDA 2026 年 AI 股权承诺约 $40B（OpenAI $30B 直投 + Corning/IREN/CoreWeave 等），占约 $300B LTM 收入远超 Lucent 1999 峰值 24%。本周关键二阶变化为收敛而非扩张——无新增大额承诺，Huang 暗示 OpenAI/Anthropic 或为最后一笔（前有 IPO），OpenAI 承诺已由约 $100B 意向缩至 $30B 实缴；循环融资口实仍在（CoreWeave $6.3B 产能采购协议为典型），维持红灯但边际收敛
indicators.note_en: A persistent red: NVDA's 2026 AI equity commitments are ~$40B ($30B direct into OpenAI plus Corning/IREN/CoreWeave and others), far above Lucent's 1999 peak of 24% against ~$300B LTM revenue. The key second-order move this week is contraction, not expansion — no new large commitment, Huang signaling the OpenAI/Anthropic stakes may be its last (ahead of IPOs), and the OpenAI commitment already trimmed from a ~$100B intent to ~$30B funded; the circular-financing critique persists (CoreWeave's $6.3B capacity-purchase agreement is the archetype) — stays red but decelerating at the margin

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: 市场广度急剧修复：S5FI 现值约 71.6%（Investing.com 71.57、区间 70.97-73.75，7/31），较上期约 48.5% 环比升约 22 个百分点，受 MSFT 财报 +15.5% 领涨；据 Carson Group，约 70% 成分股同时站上 200 日均线，为 2 月以来多数个股首次重回 50 日均线上方——头部独撑格局本周明显缓解，由黄转绿（barchart $S5FI 反爬虫 403，取 Investing.com/Seeking Alpha）
indicators.note_en: Market breadth repaired sharply: S5FI is ~71.6% (Investing.com 71.57, range 70.97-73.75, July 31), up ~22 points from last period's ~48.5%, led by Microsoft's +15.5% earnings surge; per Carson Group ~70% of members are also above their 200-day MA, the first time since February that most stocks are back above their 50-day MA — the narrow-leadership tape eased markedly this week, yellow to green (Barchart $S5FI anti-bot 403, so Investing.com / Seeking Alpha used)

indicators.name_zh: AI 龙头内部人卖买比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x = red / 5-20x = yellow / <5x = green (2000 peak: 23x)
indicators.note: 内部人卖压维持红灯，但数据源连续第 3 周不可用：openinsider 本周仍 egress 受限（curl CONNECT 与 WebFetch 均 403），12 家 30 日聚合卖/买美元比仍无法精确获取。本周具名数据点：Jensen Huang 于 7/24-28 按 10b5-1 计划卖出约 $39.16M（202,797 股 @$172-176），龙头累计卖出约 $3.3B；买盘几近归零。买盘归零使比值远超 20x，25x 为方向性估算——连续 3 期同值且始终拿不到聚合美元总额，本期标记 suspect_static、需人工核查
indicators.note_en: Insider selling stays red, but the data source is unavailable for a third straight week: openinsider remained egress-blocked (both curl CONNECT and WebFetch 403), so the 12-name 30-day aggregate dollar ratio still cannot be obtained precisely. Named data points this week: Jensen Huang sold ~$39.16M under a 10b5-1 plan on July 24-28 (202,797 shares at $172-176), with trailing leader sales ~$3.3B; buying is all but zero. Near-zero buying keeps the ratio well above 20x, and 25x is a directional estimate — the same value for three straight periods with the aggregate dollar total still unobtainable, so it is flagged suspect-static this period and needs manual review

indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood = red / Warming = yellow / Quiet = green
indicators.note: 管道继续升温但未成洪流：Anthropic 领跑——6/1 交表、承销商（GS/JPM/MS）持续排会，瞄准 9 月公开 S-1、9 月-10 月初路演、10 月首挂；OpenAI（约 $920B 保密交表）在 SpaceX 6/12 破发后倾向推迟至 2027。本周无全新 AI IPO/SPAC 公告，临近发行（6 个月内）名单实质仍只 Anthropic、总数 <10，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: The pipeline keeps warming but is short of a flood: Anthropic leads — it filed a draft S-1 on June 1, its bankers (GS/JPM/MS) keep scheduling meetings, and it targets a public S-1 in September, a roadshow in September-early October and a first trade in October; OpenAI (confidential filing at ~$920B) is leaning toward a 2027 delay after SpaceX's rocky June 12 debut. No brand-new AI IPO/SPAC announcement this week, and imminent (within-6-month) names are still essentially just Anthropic, under 10 total — stays yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: ICE BofA HY OAS 约 284bps（Convex 7/30；TradingEconomics 7 月 279bps），较上周约 277 微升 7bps，仍远低于长期均值约 394bps、中位数约 452bps，处历史最紧十分位。宽口径信用对 AI 风险仍无压力、是当前最支撑多头的指标，维持绿灯（但需并读边际：AI 债需求转挑剔、蓝筹 DC 债收益率抬升）
indicators.note_en: ICE BofA HY OAS is ~284bps (Convex July 30; TradingEconomics 279bps for July), up ~7bps from last week's ~277 and still far below the ~394bps long-run average and ~452bps median, in the historically tightest decile. Broad credit shows no stress on AI risk and is the most bull-supportive indicator right now — stays green (but read alongside the margin: pickier AI-bond demand and rising blue-chip DC-bond yields)

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: 数据中心 ABS 侧维持最紧：Cloud Capital 于 7/29 完成 $520M DC ABS（single A-2-I，Fitch/DBRS/KBRA 三家 AAA，为首笔三 AAA DC ABS），管理层称利差为 2026 中东冲突以来 DC ABS 最紧；KBRA 另给 DataBank 2026-1 预评级、发行持续健康。ABS 利差未反映压力，维持绿灯——但须并记背离：蓝筹/公司 DC 债在走阔（Meta/BlackRock $12.5B 定价 7.53%、认购覆盖由 2 月约 5x 降至 <2x），DC 债券复合体成本端已现早期应力，唯 ABS 尚紧
indicators.note_en: The data-center ABS side stays tightest: Cloud Capital closed a $520M DC ABS on July 29 (single A-2-I, triple-AAA from Fitch/DBRS/KBRA — the first triple-AAA DC ABS), with management calling the spread the tightest for a DC ABS since the 2026 Mideast conflict; KBRA also gave DataBank 2026-1 preliminary ratings amid continued healthy issuance. ABS spreads do not reflect stress — stays green, but note the divergence: blue-chip/corporate DC bonds are widening (Meta/BlackRock priced $12.5B at 7.53%, order coverage down from ~5x in February to <2x), so the broader DC-debt complex shows early cost strain even as ABS stays tight

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红 / Watch=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red / Watch = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 由绿转黄（进入观察）：CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 本周暴走至约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内股价 -36%；Moody's 于 7 月对 AI capex 威胁 MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL/CoreWeave（合计约 $460B 债务）信用质量发出行业预警。反向正面：S&P 将 CoreWeave 展望调至正面（B+）、Moody's 给其某担保工具 A3、CoreWeave 完成 $8.5B IG 级 GPU 抵押工具、Nebius $775M 定期贷款（SOFR+250）顺利落地——90 日内无已确认降级/违约。但 CDS 定价 + 行业预警 + 股价大幅回撤已达『观察』门槛，为信用轴首现火星
indicators.note_en: Green to yellow (onto Watch): CoreWeave's 5-year CDS blew out to ~855bps this week, implying ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% over the month; Moody's issued a July sector warning that AI capex threatens the credit quality of MSFT/AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL/CoreWeave (~$460B combined debt). Countervailing positives: S&P revised CoreWeave's outlook to Positive (B+), Moody's assigned A3 to one secured facility, CoreWeave closed an $8.5B IG GPU-backed facility, and Nebius closed a $775M term loan (SOFR+250) cleanly — no confirmed downgrade or default in 90 days. But the CDS repricing plus the sector warning plus deep equity drawdowns meet the 'watch' threshold — the first spark on the credit axis

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >=70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 周度台账：本周新增 $13.02B——Meta/BlackRock（Sopaipilla 合资，德州）7/27 定价 $12.5B IG 债（收益率约 7.53%、认购覆盖由 2 月约 5x 降至 <2x，为本轮 binge 蓝筹 DC 债最高收益之一，单笔 ≥$10B 入 wow_changes）+ Cloud Capital 7/29 $520M 三 AAA DC ABS。YTD 台账口径下的边际主题是蓝筹发行端资金成本抬升。台账仍沿 MS 锚定 2026E 全口径新增债务约 $570B ÷ 全口径 capex 约 $1.04T ≈ 55%（区间 50-60%），低于互联网/电信基建顶 80-100%，维持黄灯。距上次完整对账（7/6）27 天，下次约 8/9（≥28 天）做完整拆解
indicators.note_en: Weekly ledger: +$13.02B this week — Meta/BlackRock (the Sopaipilla JV, Texas) priced a $12.5B IG bond on July 27 (~7.53% yield, order coverage down from ~5x in February to <2x, one of the highest yields of this binge; a >=$10B single deal entered into wow_changes) plus Cloud Capital's $520M triple-AAA DC ABS on July 29. The marginal theme in the YTD ledger is a rising cost of capital at the blue-chip issuance end. The ledger holds MS's anchor of ~$570B of 2026E all-in new AI debt over ~$1.04T all-in capex ≈ 55% (50-60% range), below the 80-100% dot-com/telecom peak — stays yellow. 27 days since the last full reconciliation (July 6); the next full bottom-up recon is due ~Aug 9 (>=28 days)
indicators.source_name: Morgan Stanley + 自下而上台账

indicators.name_zh: AI 行业 Token 月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 静态锚本周打破：OpenRouter 吞吐升破此前约 100T/月平台至约 125T/月（约 29-33T/周、日破 1 万亿 token；Menlo/COO 口径年化仍约 1.5 quadrillion），较持平 5 期的约 100T 上升约 25%，故撤下 suspect_static。但需并记新鲜度：openrouter.ai/rankings 实时页 403，约 125T 源自 6-7 月二手报道、约 4-8 周旧、非 8 月现值读数。行业绝对用量续处高位扩张、无收缩，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: The static anchor broke this week: OpenRouter throughput rose above the prior ~100T/month plateau to ~125T/month (~29-33T/week, over 1 trillion tokens/day; Menlo/COO framing still a ~1.5-quadrillion annual run-rate), up ~25% off the ~100T carried for five periods, so suspect-static is dropped. Note the freshness caveat, though: the live openrouter.ai/rankings page 403'd, and the ~125T figure derives from June-July secondary reporting (~4-8 weeks old), not a fresh August read. Industry usage remains at a high, expanding level with no contraction — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: H100 SXM on-demand 市场中位约 $3.2-3.5/hr（ComputePrices/CloudZero 口径，最低现货低至约 $0.35-1.14），较上周单点约 $3.94 边际转松（口径含更多低价供应商，非同篮子）；H200 中位约 $3.72-4.11 大体持平。可得性混合——Lambda 部分缺货、专业云有货，无广泛过剩。算力供需最直接温度计仍偏紧、维持绿灯，但 on-demand 商品端阴跌为下期需盯的软信号（Blackwell 放量后尤需警惕）
indicators.note_en: H100 SXM on-demand market median is ~$3.2-3.5/hr (ComputePrices/CloudZero basis, spot as low as ~$0.35-1.14), a marginal softening from last week's single ~$3.94 point (the basket now spans more low-cost providers, so not apples-to-apples); H200 median ~$3.72-4.11 is roughly flat. Availability is mixed — Lambda shows pockets of out-of-stock while specialist clouds have inventory, with no broad glut. As the most direct thermometer of compute supply-demand it stays firm and green, but the drift lower at the on-demand commodity end is a soft signal to watch next period (especially once Blackwell ramps)

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，无 8 月新披露、沿用 7 月台账：Anthropic ARR 年化跑量 7 月约 $74.1B（6 月约 $69.6B），单月增量约 +$4.5B（前期约 +$17B），增速回落、二阶导转负续存；OpenAI 约 $41.3B（+65% 区间）仍加速，CFO 称 7 月年化收入已超整个 Q2。两家二阶导混合（Anthropic 减速抵消 OpenAI 加速），判为『平稳/见顶迹象』黄灯（本周无新增数据点，待 8 月披露确认趋势）
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow with no August print, carrying the July ledger: Anthropic's annualized ARR run-rate was ~$74.1B in July (~$69.6B in June), a monthly increment of ~+$4.5B (from ~+$17B) — the growth rate rolling over with a still-negative second derivative; OpenAI is ~$41.3B (~+65%) and still accelerating, with its CFO noting July annualized revenue already topped all of Q2. The two second derivatives are mixed (Anthropic decel offsetting OpenAI accel), so the read is 'flattening / topping signs' (yellow) — no new data point this week, pending an August print to confirm the trend

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: McKinsey Q1 2026：72% 企业至少 1 项 AI workload 生产化（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%）。本周无新 Q2 整体生产化读数（季度调查），仅见 agent 专项数据：约 31% 企业已有 ≥1 个 AI agent 进入生产、约 28% 规模化；Gartner/IDC 中值料 2027 Q1 跨行业生产化达约 48-55%。头部部署率高位、维持绿灯（沿用 Q1，Q2 整体调查待发布）
indicators.note_en: McKinsey Q1 2026: 72% of enterprises run at least one AI workload in production (vs 55% in 2024, 20% in 2020). No new Q2 overall production-rate print this week (quarterly survey); only agent-specific data surfaced — ~31% have at least one AI agent in production and ~28% at scale, with Gartner/IDC midpoints projecting ~48-55% cross-industry production by Q1 2027. The headline rate stays high — stays green (Q1 carried, the Q2 overall survey pending)

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 订单积压本周再创纪录、加速：MSFT 商业 RPO 升至 $678B（+84% YoY，除 OpenAI 亦 +25%，约 30% 于 12 个月内确认）、Amazon RPO 升至 $496B（环比 +$132B、三位数 YoY，AWS run-rate 约 $169B），叠加 Google 积压 $514B、Oracle RPO $638B，大三 hyperscaler 积压合计约 $1.69T（另加 Oracle）。订单强劲且加速，维持绿灯（Oracle 客户集中于 OpenAI 仍为结构性隐患）
indicators.note_en: Backlogs hit new records and accelerated this week: MSFT commercial RPO rose to $678B (+84% YoY, +25% ex-OpenAI, ~30% recognizable within 12 months) and Amazon RPO to $496B (+$132B sequentially, triple-digit YoY, AWS run-rate ~$169B), which with Google's $514B backlog and Oracle's $638B RPO puts big-3 hyperscaler backlog at ~$1.69T (plus Oracle). The order book is strong and accelerating — stays green (Oracle's concentration in OpenAI remains a structural risk)

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 前沿进展仍在轨且偏加速：近 90 天旗舰密集——Anthropic Claude Opus 5（7/24）、OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol、xAI Grok 4.5（7/8）。困难基准 SOTA（约 7/27）：HLE Claude Fable 5 仍居首 53.3%、GPQA GPT-5.6 Sol 94.6%、SWE-bench Pro Fable 5 80.3%、FrontierMath GPT-5.6 Sol 约 89%。METR 时程主锚：公开最强约 12h（50%），倍增时间修订为约 4 个月（快于此前约 7 月轨道）。capex 第一性支撑（模型持续变好解锁场景）完好，维持绿灯（对比台账上期无实质放缓）
indicators.note_en: Frontier progress stays on-trend and if anything accelerating: flagships clustered in the last 90 days — Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 (July 24), OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, and xAI's Grok 4.5 (July 8). Hard-benchmark SOTA (~July 27): HLE Claude Fable 5 still leads at 53.3%, GPQA GPT-5.6 Sol 94.6%, SWE-bench Pro Fable 5 80.3%, FrontierMath GPT-5.6 Sol ~89%. METR's primary anchor: the public best is ~12h (50%), with doubling time revised to ~4 months (faster than the prior ~7-month track). The first-principles support for capex (models keep improving, unlocking use cases) is intact — stays green (no material slowdown versus the prior ledger reading)

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本周核心 AI 龙头无新增正式执法：现有条目均为私人证券诉讼而非监管执法——CoreWeave 集体诉讼（1/12 D.N.J.）、Oracle 债权人诉讼（1/14，涉 $18B 债发行文件）；Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle『循环融资/round-tripping』仍属分析师/批评者审视，无正式立案。round-tripping 议论量在上升（黄色隐忧），但无监管开启 AI 专项欺诈执法，核心龙头未触及，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: No new formal enforcement against a core AI bellwether this week: existing items are private securities litigation, not regulatory enforcement — the CoreWeave class action (Jan 12, D.N.J.) and the Oracle bondholder suit (Jan 14, re: $18B bond-offering documents); the Nvidia->OpenAI->CoreWeave/Oracle 'circular financing / round-tripping' loop remains analyst/critic scrutiny with no formal probe. The volume of round-tripping commentary is rising (a yellow-tint concern), but no regulator has opened an AI-specific fraud enforcement and core leaders remain untouched — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: 7/29 FOMC 维持 3.50-3.75%（第 5 次连续维持），但 9-3 投票、3 位异议者要求加息（鹰派异议）；点阵图年末 3.6-4.1%，市场现已定价 2026 年两次加息、2027 年前无降息。较上周（约 63.5% 维持、加息尾部风险）鹰派倾斜进一步加深，『降息=绿』情景出局；但实际动作仍是维持而非加息，政策属『维持高利率(通胀压力)』，未改判黄灯——鹰派尾部风险是黄区内的边际恶化
indicators.note_en: The July 29 FOMC held at 3.50-3.75% (a fifth consecutive hold), but on a 9-3 vote with three dissents wanting a HIKE (hawkish dissents); the dot plot shows year-end 3.6-4.1%, and markets now price two 2026 hikes and no cuts through 2027. Versus last week (~63.5% hold odds with a hike as tail risk), the hawkish tilt has deepened and the 'cut = green' scenario is off the table; but the actual action was a hold, not a hike, so policy sits at 'higher-for-longer hold (inflation pressure)' and is not re-rated — the hawkish tail is a marginal deterioration within the yellow band

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 由红回落至黄：MSFT/Meta/Amazon Q2（7/29-30）落地，市场明确『分化』而非无差别惩罚——MSFT 7/30 暴涨约 15-16%、单日市值增约 $4500 亿（史上单只个股最大单日美元增值，Azure +43%、RPO $678B）、Amazon 涨约 10%（AWS +37%、RPO $496B）均因 capex 有需求佐证获奖励；唯 Meta 因 FCF 塌陷 -91% 被罚约 -9%。反应函数由『系统性惩罚』（红）回到『选择性/偶发惩罚』（黄），奖励有对价的 capex、只罚烧现金无对价者，上周红灯判定被证明过早
indicators.note_en: Red back to yellow: with MSFT/Meta/Amazon Q2 landing (July 29-30), the market clearly discriminated rather than punished indiscriminately — MSFT surged ~15-16% on July 30 for a ~$450B single-day gain (the largest one-day dollar gain for any stock in history, Azure +43%, RPO $678B) and Amazon rose ~10% (AWS +37%, RPO $496B), both rewarded for capex backed by demand, while only Meta was punished ~-9% on its -91% FCF collapse. The reaction function moved from 'systematic punishment' (red) back to 'selective/episodic punishment' (yellow), rewarding capex with receipts and punishing only cash-burning capex without them — last week's red call proved premature

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热=红 / 部分=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态持续但未成一致：Sam Altman 本月以 dot-com 泡沫类比 AI（『聪明人会对一颗真理内核过度兴奋』、部分初创估值『膨胀』），但长期框定为『巨大净赢』；Pichai 续称『AI 支出仍合理』、Zuckerberg 看多（卖智能毛利 > 卖算力）。与此同时各家 Q2 集体加码 capex（Amazon 升至 $220B、MSFT FY27 $255-260B），无一 CEO 在承认过热的同时收缩支出，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Hedging continues but is not universal: Sam Altman this month likened AI to the dot-com bubble ('smart people get overexcited about a kernel of truth', some startup valuations 'inflated') while framing the long term as 'a huge net win'; Pichai keeps saying 'AI spending still makes sense' and Zuckerberg is bullish (margins on selling intelligence > selling compute). Meanwhile all raised capex at Q2 (Amazon to $220B, MSFT FY27 $255-260B), and no CEO is conceding an overheated market while cutting spend — stays yellow
